metadata.caption:
The recipe can stay the same. The chocolate doesn’t have to.

Cocoa-butter crystals and the larger fat-crystal network can rebuild differently after melting. Tempering guides that rebuilding.

Simplified explanatory models, not a tempering tutorial. Original Magnivis visuals with synthetic narration.
